basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go trainer originally from Seattle, now residing in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to raid and explore during off-peak hours. I'm passionate about anime, especially anything related to the Pokémon universe. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people through online gaming communities. Typically, I'm online late at night and early morning. I dislike cluttered notifications and prefer to keep my friend lists clean.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in design, having graduated with a degree in Graphic Design from the University of Washington. My passion for Pokémon started as a kid, and I've self-taught myself about the game's mechanics through countless hours of gameplay and community forums.
